title: Rav Acha son of Rav Chiyya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He asks Rav Ashi a question in [Nedarim 10b (Hyman cites 10a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.10b.9); Hyman writes that it seems the reading should be “son of Rava.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman’s supplied locator is Nedarim 10a, retained in the translation. The matching question of Acha son of Chiyya before Rav Ashi occurs in the William Davidson digital text of Nedarim 10b. “Son of Rava” remains Hyman’s tentative emendation, not an adopted genealogy.
The linked Nedarim has Rav Acha son of Rav Chiyya ask Rav Ashi about the meaning of kinah. Hyman tentatively proposes the patronymic son of Rava.
